# Red Stag Construction

> Licensed general contractor and design-build firm in Los Angeles, California, founded in 2011. Custom homes, ADUs, kitchen and bathroom remodels, home additions, hardscape, fencing, window replacement, construction management and development services. CSLB license #964664 (B General Building, C-6, C-36).

- Business name: Red Stag Construction
- Address: 3211 Cahuenga Boulevard West, STE 207, Los Angeles, CA 90068
- Phone: (323) 922-4235
- Email: support@redstagcc.com
- Website: [redstagcc.com](https://redstagcc.com/)
- Google Business Profile: [Red Stag Construction on Google Maps](https://www.google.com/maps?cid=1546060090964512284)
- Service areas: Los Angeles, Burbank, Glendale, Pasadena, Universal City, Encino, Sherman Oaks, Studio City, Beverly Hills, Bel Air, Malibu, Santa Monica, Calabasas
